name: Default
shortDescription: SMTP server and web interface for testing email during development: catches every message your apps send and shows HTML, text, headers and attachments.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the MAILDEV_WEB_PASS value from the environment variables. The same credentials protect the REST API.
Only the web UI and API are published. The SMTP server is reachable only from apps in the same environment at maildev:1025, with no authentication and no TLS.
